allow_once.title: Allow [[key]] once every [[duration]] [[duration_unit]]
allow_once.hint: Checks whether the cooldown is active, atomically activates it if allowed, and returns true to continue the Flow or false to stop it.

allow_up_to.title: Allow [[key]] up to [[max_count]] times every [[duration]] [[duration_unit]]
allow_up_to.hint: Checks whether the key can still run in the current interval, counts as one time if allowed, and returns true to continue the Flow or false to stop it.

blocked_count_reached.title: [[key]] blocked [[count]] times in a row
blocked_count_reached.hint: Runs when the Allow condition blocks exactly the chosen number of times in a row since the last allowed run. Passes the current block count as a Flow tag.

blocked_count_at_least.title: [[key]] blocked [[count]] or more times in a row
blocked_count_at_least.titleFormatted: [[key]] blocked [[count]] or more times in a row
blocked_count_at_least.hint: Runs when the Allow condition has blocked at least the chosen number of times in a row since the last allowed run. Passes the current block count as a Flow tag.

reset_cooldown.title: Reset cooldown for [[key]]
reset_cooldown.hint: Clears the cooldown for the selected key so it can trigger again immediately.

suspend_cooldown.title: Suspend cooldown for [[key]]
suspend_cooldown.hint: Registers the cooldown as if it just ran, blocking further triggers until the duration defined in the Allow condition has elapsed. Also blocks Allow up to keys until reset.

reset_token_count.title: Reset times used for [[key]]
reset_token_count.hint: Clears how many times this key has been used, so the full max times is available again in the current interval.

grant_token.title: Restore one time for [[key]]
grant_token.hint: Makes one more run available for this key in the current interval.

grant_tokens.title: Restore [[token_count]] times for [[key]]
grant_tokens.hint: Makes that many more runs available for this key in the current interval.

errors.duration_invalid: Cooldown duration must be greater than 0.
errors.max_count_invalid: Max times must be a whole number of 1 or greater.
errors.token_count_invalid: Times must be a whole number of 1 or greater.

settings.empty: No cooldown keys yet. Add a key in a Flow card to see it here.
settings.error_allow_key_conflicting_durations: Key "__key__" is used in multiple And cards with different durations (__durations__). Use the same duration everywhere for a key.
settings.error_allow_key_invalid_duration: Key "__key__" has an And card with a missing or invalid duration. Duration must be a whole number of at least 1 with a valid unit, or a Flow tag.
settings.error_action_key_without_allow: Key "__key__" is used in a Then card but has no matching And card. These cards have no effect.
settings.error_trigger_key_without_allow: Key "__key__" is used in a When card but has no matching And card. This card will never run.
settings.error_allow_up_to_key_conflicting_limits: Key "__key__" is used in multiple And cards with different limits (__limits__). Use the same max times and duration everywhere for a key.
settings.error_allow_up_to_key_invalid_limit: Key "__key__" has an And card with a missing or invalid max times or duration. Max times must be a whole number of 1 or greater, or a Flow tag. Duration must be a whole number of at least 1 with a valid unit, or a Flow tag.
settings.error_grant_tokens_key_invalid_token_cou: Key "__key__" has a Then card with a missing or invalid number of times. Times must be a whole number of 1 or greater, or a Flow tag.
settings.error_allow_key_mixed_card_types: Key "__key__" is used in both Allow once and Allow up to And cards. Use only one card type per key, unless the Allow up to card uses a max times of exactly 1.
